notes: The booklet has three models (sea plane, sailing catamaran, hovercraft) that all reuse the same 53 pieces, so each physical piece is listed once. The sea plane (pages 2-13, with the floats built on pages 10-13 and attached in step 14) is recorded in full. It uses 47 pieces.

The 6 pieces the sea plane does not use are b48-b53: 2 white 1x2 bricks, 2 orange 1x3 tiles, 1 orange 1x2 plate and the black handle plate. They are recorded where they sit in the alternate models, on re-used pieces: b48/b49 are stacked on white wedge b16, b50/b51 sit on the gray wedges, b52 sits on orange plates b14 and b25, and b53 is clipped to b14.
Because the pieces are re-used, those 6 placements are best guesses from small pictures and are not part of the plane.
Tail base plate b15 is given an id before the tail wedges, even though the booklet adds it last, so every rests_on points to an earlier id. The tail wedges physically sit on its studs.

Silver round plates b8/b9 and b11/b12 are modelled as attached to the vertical faces of brackets b7 and b10 (other_joins). Each bracket's top plate sits across both rows of the 2x6 hull plates (b1, b2). The 2x2 pin brick b13 sits on both brackets.

Float arm b45 is a 1x6 plate lying on the free studs of the two bar-up plates b39 and b43. Each float's curved black hull piece is recorded as sitting on its 1x4 plate (b37/b41). The orange curved 4x1 pieces sit on the black curved pieces.

The orange 1x2 plate b4 is placed on the slope's top studs. The orange 2x4 plate b14 covers the 2x2 pin brick, both gray side-stud bricks and b4, so b14 rests on all four. The wedge-plate wing sits on the tail base b15. The 2x2 orange plate b25 straddles the two wedges. Bows b26/b27 sit on b15.
Which of b25 (2x2) or b14 (2x4) goes where could not be settled for certain from the small pictures; the pieces and counts are right.
Element/colour assignments follow the parts list. Clip b46 grips silver plate b8 and clip b47 grips b11. The exact pairing is a guess.
